title: Canteen cart with a combo discount

authoring.author: Parikshaa content team
authoring.originality: Written for Parikshaa: our own project brief, code, tests and rubric for canteen cart with a combo discount, examples, code, quiz and explanations; no text from any site, book or course.

brief: Build the cart behind the canteen's pre-order app: students add and remove items, see their cart, and get 10% off big orders. You write the `Cart` class; a driver reads commands from standard input so every test is a short script you can also type by hand.
requirements: Items come from the menu in menu.py; anything else is refused with an error.
Quantities are 1-20 per command, and at most 20 of any one item in the cart.
LIST prints items sorted by name with their line amount, or 'cart is empty'.
TOTAL takes 10% off (rounded down) when the subtotal is 200 or more, and says how much was saved.
io_protocol:
One command per line:

| Command | Prints |
|---|---|
| `ADD <item> <qty>` | `added <qty> <item>`, or an `error: ...` line |
| `REMOVE <item> <qty>` | `removed <qty> <item>`, `removed all <item>` (when qty ≥ what is in the cart), or `error: <item> not in cart` |
| `LIST` | one line `<item> x<qty> = <amount>` per item, sorted by item name, or `cart is empty` |
| `TOTAL` | `total <n>`, or `total <n> (saved <s>)` when the discount applies |

Anything else prints `error: bad command <the line>`. Errors: `error: unknown item <item>`, `error: quantity must be 1-20`, `error: at most 20 <item> per order`.

milestones.title: Add and list
milestones.instructions: Make `add` store quantities in `self._items` and `lines` return the sorted lines. Run the first visible test.
hints: Use dict.get(item, 0) to add to a quantity that may not exist yet.

milestones.title: Remove and refuse
milestones.instructions: Add the three add errors and the remove command. A remove of more than is in the cart removes the item completely.
hints: Check the menu first, then the quantity range, then the 20-per-item limit.
del self._items[item] removes the key so LIST no longer shows it.

milestones.title: Total with the combo discount
milestones.instructions: Return (total, saved) from `total`. 10% off, rounded down, when the subtotal is 200 or more.
hints: subtotal // 10 is 10% rounded down for whole rupees.
A subtotal of exactly 200 gets the discount.

rubric.criterion: Hidden tests pass: every command prints exactly the expected output.
The Cart keeps its own rules: quantities validated in add, no other code edits _items, and money kept as whole rupees.
Readable names, small functions and clear error handling (AI feedback, advice only).

extensions: Add a coupon command that takes a code and a flat amount off.
Keep an order history and print the most ordered item.
